obligations.name: repair_statement
obligations.statement: ∀ H : Nat, Audit_reddit_math_2s4u2m.FitsBits Audit_reddit_math_2s4u2m.bits H → Audit_reddit_math_2s4u2m.HasAtMostDecDigits H Audit_reddit_math_2s4u2m.digitBound

obligations.name: final_theorem
obligations.statement: (Nat.digits 10 Audit_reddit_math_2s4u2m.maximum).length = Audit_reddit_math_2s4u2m.digitBound ∧ ∀ H : Nat, Audit_reddit_math_2s4u2m.FitsBits Audit_reddit_math_2s4u2m.bits H → (Nat.digits 10 H).length ≤ Audit_reddit_math_2s4u2m.digitBound

repair_template_chunks: def CorrectedDigitCount : Prop := (∀ H : Nat, FitsBits bits H → HasAtMostDecDigits H digitBound) ∧ HasDecDigits maximum digitBound

environment.isolation: bubblewrap (no network, tmpfs HOME + ~/.elan, workspace + read-only common packages)

rule.note: a single natural-number literal; arithmetic (e.g. 170156 + 1), Nat.log/Nat.digits expressions or names are excluded syntactically (an expression definitionally equal to the constant would pass every kernel check and the agreement test; check_record.sh / validate.py apply this grammar)

reserved_names.rule: a declaration (def/theorem/lemma/abbrev/instance/structure/inductive/class/opaque/axiom/irreducible_def/alias) is rejected when its name equals a reserved identifier, or its last component equals the last component of one, or it is `_root_.`-qualified; reserved = task.json reserved_names + every identifier of the template's fixed text and the obligation statements + the record namespace + evaluator.json hole_syntax.allowed_identifiers; template declarations and obligation names are exempt; `export`, `namespace` other than the record namespace and aliasing `open` forms are rejected
